headline: Quinshon Judkins scores twice, and Tara would like a word with everyone who told her to bench him
dek: Jaxon Smith-Njigba beat Samantha more or less by himself. Maddie's quarterback situation remains under investigation. And Kyra won a game she would prefer we didn't recap. We're recapping it.

matchups.2-7: Jaxon Smith-Njigba scored 31.3 and Amie won by 42.46. Samantha started the best lineup on her entire roster, which turns out to be a great way to lose with dignity.
matchups.3-4: Tara spent September refusing to bench Quinshon Judkins while the whole league yelled at her. She will now be accepting apologies in the group chat. Maddie's best tight end watched the whole thing from her bench.
matchups.1-8: Marlee scored the most points in the league, which turned out to be exactly enough to beat Cambri. By 12.58. Barely.
matchups.5-6: Kyra missed her own projection by 26 points and won anyway, the fantasy equivalent of showing up to work in pajamas and getting promoted. Maya scored the fewest points in the league.

game_balls.title: Ground and air, both covered
game_balls.text: Javonte Williams handled the ground, Amon-Ra St. Brown handled the air, and Marlee handled clicking the button that started them. League high score.

game_balls.title: A one-man group project
game_balls.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught nine passes for 150 yards and a touchdown. The rest of Amie's roster was also technically there.

game_balls.title: Tight end, loose definition
game_balls.text: Trey McBride caught ten passes and a touchdown, which is a lot of receiving for a position that's supposed to spend half its day blocking.

flags.title: One swap away from winning
flags.text: Cambri started Derrick Henry, who scored 5.9. Tony Pollard scored three touchdowns on her bench. One swap and she wins. She started Henry.

flags.title: Exhibit A
flags.text: Maya benched Luther Burden III for Jalen Coker, who caught one pass. Burden caught a touchdown and a 130-yard afternoon. The recap would like the record to show it was written by the defendant.

tough_breaks.title: Nothing left to give
tough_breaks.text: Samantha started the best possible lineup from her roster and still lost. There was nothing to fix and nothing to learn. Sometimes the other team just has Jaxon Smith-Njigba.

tough_breaks.title: The curse has a third victim
tough_breaks.text: Bryce Young threw two interceptions and lost a fumble. He joins Jaxson Dart and Tyler Shough in the special wing of the building where Maddie's quarterbacks go to rest.

glossary.definition: A roster spot for a player hurt badly enough to need real recovery time. He sits there without counting against your bench limit, but he also can't score you a single point, just ask whoever is parking Travis Etienne Jr. there this week.
When a quarterback gets tackled before he can throw the ball. Bad for his stat line, great for whoever owns the defense that did it. The Vikings D/ST notched four of them for Marlee this week.
A pass caught by the other team's defense instead of yours, which costs the quarterback two points. Bryce Young threw two of them on his way to a 5.42-point week.

A kick through the uprights, worth more the farther out it comes from. Brandon Aubrey made three of them for Cambri this week, including one from way downtown, worth 11 points on their own; three extra points pushed his night to 14.
